title: John Lennon visits Paramount Studios | 1974
content:
John Lennon and May Pang took Cynthia and Julian Lennon on a tour of Paramount Studios on 14 January 1974.

Cynthia and Julian had been in Los Angeles since just after Christmas, and remained there for the first few weeks of January.

At Paramount they visited the sets of Happy Days, Mannix, The Magician, and Mission: Impossible, and were in the studio audience for the filming of an episode of The Odd Couple. That episode was broadcast by ABC on 8 March.
